scope: These 27 README entries include analyses, structural rewrites, policies, and specialized lowerings; they are not 27 independently scheduled passes. LLVM optimization stages are separate.

entries.name: Symbolic index and effect analysis
entries.summary: Prove index equivalence, stride, variable use, and effects.
entries.guard: Integer coordinates and supported operators; non-affine products decline.
entries.description: Canonicalizes supported affine expressions, checks uses/equality/strides, and provides inputs to pass-specific bounds and ownership proofs. Unsupported expressions stop the relevant rewrite.

entries.name: Storage typing
entries.summary: Keep half storage separate from explicit FP32 arithmetic.
entries.guard: f16/f32 global buffers, control-only indices, explicit f32 results, plain stores.
entries.description: Validates half/float types before rewrites and lowering: explicit FP32 arithmetic, control-only indices, and ordinary output stores.

entries.name: Elementwise vectorization
entries.summary: Turn scalar thread-strided loops into four values per lane.
entries.guard: Extent divisible by 4×threads; contiguous indices; safe overlap and lifetimes.
entries.description: Converts contiguous thread-strided scalar loops to four elements per lane. Requires divisible extents, safe overlap, closed temporaries, and ordinary stores.

entries.name: Reduction load forwarding
entries.summary: Reuse reduction inputs in registers in the following consumer.
entries.guard: Readonly matching input, no writes, intervening CTA barrier, ≤8 vector trips.
entries.description: Keeps input vectors in registers across a reduction and its consumer, removing repeated global loads. Proves matching indices, readonly inputs, and closed lifetimes.

entries.name: Recurrence-axis reordering
entries.summary: Move score-independent tile axes into the lane-sharing position.
entries.guard: Closed named coordinates, exact tile coverage, no rasterization, wider sharing.
entries.description: Reorders logical tile axes to increase provable lane sharing while retaining the physical launch and output mapping.

entries.name: Split-K grid folding
entries.summary: Merge split-K partitions into deeper per-CTA contractions.
entries.guard: Atomic dense contraction; affine coverage; depth≤32, shared≤48 KiB, enough work.
entries.description: Folds an output-independent atomic contraction axis into deeper per-CTA K work. Guards affine coverage, shared memory, and remaining parallelism; surplus physical CTAs exit through the tile guard.

entries.name: Cooperative dot reduction
entries.summary: Share a repeated dot product across a power-of-two lane group.
entries.guard: Closed load/load/product/sum loop, full warps, uniform scope, width≤32.
entries.description: Distributes a repeated dot product across a power-of-two lane group and combines partial sums with shuffles. Requires full participating warps and closed scalar/index scope.

entries.name: Coalesced sum/square reduction
entries.summary: Coalesce sum/square loads and pipeline long register reductions.
entries.guard: Seeded sum/square with matching warp/tree reduction; long path also readonly.
entries.description: Maps thread-strided reductions to contiguous vector loads. Long eligible loops use independent FP32 accumulators and alternating load batches; explicit unroll settings bypass that automatic pipeline.

entries.name: Small-tree elimination
entries.summary: Replace small shared reduction trees with direct loads and adds.
entries.guard: 2–8 power-of-two partials, producer barrier, exclusive scratch, closed states.
entries.description: Replaces closed trees of 2–8 warp partials with direct shared loads and balanced scalar addition; eligible multiple-state trees use a subgroup shuffle. Requires the producer barrier and exclusive scratch lifetime.

entries.name: Warp tree specialization
entries.summary: Let warp 0 finish a warp-partial tree and broadcast the result.
entries.guard: Enabled specialization, warp-indexed tree, no inner dimension, length≤32.
entries.description: Lets warp 0 combine up to 32 warp partials and broadcast through shared memory with one CTA barrier. Other trees retain generic shared-memory reduction.

entries.name: Contraction tensorization
entries.summary: Recognize dense shared-memory contractions for compensated MMA.
entries.guard: Complete affine tiles, full warps, closed scalar scope, supported M/N/K sizes.
entries.description: Recognizes dense shared-memory multiply/add contractions and emits BF16x3 or TF32x3 MMA. Proves complete affine output tiles, full warps, supported dimensions, and scalar ownership.

entries.name: Tensor shared-memory layout
entries.summary: Match tensor producers and consumers with bank-aware layouts.
entries.guard: Recognized tensor operands; compatible dimensions and packed BF16 eligibility.
entries.description: Applies matching producer/consumer bank remapping and packed layouts; uses `ldmatrix` for eligible BF16 fragments.

entries.name: Packed register staging
entries.summary: Replace a certified copy ring with register prefetch and packed data.
entries.guard: Exact original future phase, complete aligned copies, readonly inputs, closed ring.
entries.description: Replaces a certified asynchronous matrix-copy ring with vector global prefetches, BF16 high/residual packing, and one packed shared stage. Checks original clamped future coordinates, alignment, bounds, and ownership.

entries.name: Tensor fragment pipelining
entries.summary: Load the next MMA fragment before consuming the current fragment.
entries.guard: Certified packed BF16 operands; compatible fragment depth and loop bounds.
entries.description: Carries current MMA fragments in loop phis and loads the next fragment before consuming the current one. Keeps the fragment loop compact; the outer packed K loop defaults to unroll two.

entries.name: Pipeline drain
entries.summary: Skip the final unused prefetch and consumer barrier.
entries.guard: Certified staging loop with uniform next-tile predicate and no later shared users.
entries.description: Omits the final unused register prefetch and consumer barrier when no next K tile exists. Producer stores and their barrier remain; the staging proof excludes later shared users.

entries.name: Staged online recurrence
entries.summary: Stage recognized score/max/mass/value recurrences into GPU phases.
entries.guard: Exact recurrence algebra, readonly operands, uniform scale, bounded rounds/scratch.
entries.description: Recognizes max/mass/weighted-sum recurrences, computes scores once, and separates normalization from value accumulation using shared probabilities. May stage reusable readonly operands with `cp.async` under traffic/scratch-budget guards.

entries.name: Blocked recurrence loads and address hoisting
entries.summary: Group contiguous key rounds and hoist affine value addresses.
entries.guard: Compatible 2/4 key rounds; unstaged operands; affine bounded full value coverage.
entries.description: Groups contiguous key rounds for vector loads and hoists affine value-gather bases. Requires full coverage, compatible staging, and bounded positive strides.

entries.name: Warp-distributed vector PV reduction
entries.summary: Distribute PV keys across four groups and vectorize four columns.
entries.guard: Single full warp, 32 columns, one component, full ownership, replayable suffix.
entries.description: For certified single-warp, 32-column recurrences, four groups distribute keys while each lane accumulates four adjacent columns. Shuffles combine groups. Proves alignment, unique output ownership, and closed per-column suffix replay; restores the denominator each time.

entries.name: Recurrence shared-storage reuse
entries.summary: Reuse dead staged-operand storage for shared probabilities.
entries.guard: Same warp/component ownership; finite negative identity; bounded full mapping.
entries.description: Reuses dead staged-operand storage for probabilities when every overwritten read belongs to the same warp/component. Read-to-maximum-to-store dependence orders reuse; otherwise scratch remains separate.

entries.name: Hybrid row normalizer
entries.summary: Separate row maximum work from owned-value exponentials and mass.
entries.guard: Closed max/mass tree, finite seed, 64–256 threads, bounded rows, approximate math.
entries.description: Each warp obtains the row maximum, each thread exponentiates its owned values, and only scalar mass crosses warps. Requires a closed max/mass tree, bounded work, and approximate math enabled.

entries.name: Ordered hardware warp maximum
entries.summary: Use integer warp redux for proven non-NaN FP32 maximum.
entries.guard: Full warp; non-NaN identity fold; recurrence CTA must have more than 32 threads.
entries.description: Maps proven non-NaN FP32 values to ordered integer keys for `redux.sync.max.s32`, then reverses the mapping. Used for full warps in certified normalizers and multi-warp recurrences; single-warp recurrences retain shuffles.

entries.name: CTA/thread address factoring
entries.summary: Decode CTA axes and thread axes separately.
entries.guard: Trailing-axis product equals block width; no rasterization; bounded tile ownership.
entries.description: Separates leading CTA axes from trailing thread axes when their product matches the block width. Avoids repeated full-ticket division; guards bounds, rasterization, and partial-grid ownership.

entries.name: Loop cost policy
entries.summary: Choose structure-sensitive LLVM unroll and vectorization hints.
entries.guard: Recognized loop structure; explicit options; specialized coalesced-loop policy.
entries.description: Supplies structure-sensitive unroll/vectorization hints. Explicit options remain authoritative; this is a heuristic policy, not runtime autotuning.

entries.name: Reciprocal-square-root folding
entries.summary: Recognize adjacent sqrt-to-reciprocal dataflow for approximate rsqrt.
entries.guard: Adjacent matching assignments, no self-overwrite, approximate math enabled.
entries.description: Folds adjacent sqrt→reciprocal dataflow to approximate reciprocal square root when enabled.

entries.name: Dead atomic-result elimination
entries.summary: Use a PTX reduction when an atomic add result is unused.
entries.guard: Recognized FP32 global-add form and no later destination-register use.
entries.description: Changes unused-result atomic add to PTX reduction while retaining recognized predicate/order/scope qualifiers.

entries.name: Fixed block contract
entries.summary: Express the fixed launch width as a PTX block-size requirement.
entries.guard: Recognized maxntid directive and the compiler’s fixed-launch contract.
entries.description: Changes `.maxntid` to `.reqntid` for the launch's fixed thread dimensions.

entries.name: Approximate division cleanup
entries.summary: Select approximate FP32 division only when enabled.
entries.guard: approximate_math enabled and an exact div.rn.f32 opcode match.
entries.description: Selects approximate division lowering only when the corresponding math option is enabled.
